name: BoomBap
description: Tempo-synced boom-bap kit. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat (4ppqn), not the tap moment. Classic boom kick + hard snares on 2 and 4. X grows dusty ghost snares/rims; Y thickens swung hats. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill.

params.name: GHOST
params.detail: Ghost-note density (soft snares/rims around the backbeat)
